name: tldr
description: TL;DR for Claude Code: every turn as one card, with what to check.

card.title: Turn card
card.description: Fold each turn's tool calls into one TL;DR row: what changed, how the tests went, what to check. Off: Claude Code draws its own rows, and trust, keep, actions and notify turn off too.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: The mode-aware spinner, and the band line while a turn runs: the running step against how long it took last time, and the last test result or flag.

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: Moving frames, the band clock ticking each second, and short highlights. Off: motion redraws only when a step lands.

context.title: Context bar
context.description: A bar above the prompt: what fills the context window, by category, and how much is left. /tldr context lists it.

trust.title: Trust flags
trust.description: Flag what to check, one line each on the card: test files changed to pass, writes outside the project, deletes, skipped tests, --no-verify or force push.

keep.title: Keep cards
keep.description: Save finished cards so they stay after /compact and a resume. /tldr history lists them.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: /tldr copy copies the reply as clean text; /tldr diff prints the turn's net diff.

notify.title: Notify
notify.description: When a turn over 30 seconds ends: a notification with its verdict, and the same on the status line until your next prompt.
